# R5.13 — Deduplicated incurred-use and unknown-exposure views

**Summary.** Implements the Account owner's physical-use fold (PADR-R5-2
B.1 item 4, admitted GATE-G9): `Account::physical_use` exposes physical
incurred/billed/unknown use **beside** — never merged into — the logical
scope totals, and the experiment/results consumers count propagated
leaf/ancestor copies of one charge **once** (the admitted dedup
semantics, B.3). Ticket `docs/tickets/182_R5.13__physical.md` (seq 182).

## What changed

- `crates/hh-budget/src/tree.rs` — `PhysicalUse{incurred,
  incurred_by_charged_to, billed_micro_units, unknown}` +
  `UnknownExposure`/`UnknownExposureReason`; `BudgetTree::physical_use`
  computes the view from `charges_by_source`/`spend_rows`/
  `unknown_exposures` — each `(source_event, dimension)` charge once at
  its leaf-most node (no revert exclusion: physical spend survives
  logical reversal; `released` rows never subtract); `unknown_exposures`
  folds `model.call.completed{usage.available:false}` and
  `model.call.failed` without `usage`, deduplicated on `event_id`,
  never folded into a numeric total.
- `crates/hh-budget/src/account.rs`, `lib.rs` — `Account::physical_use`
  + exports. No new event class, dimension, dependency or wire member.
- `crates/hh-experiment/src/engine.rs` — `consumed_vector` deduplicates
  propagated copies on `(source_event.event_id, dimension)` (the
  Account's own `is_charged` key): settle transfers execution cost
  once; unkeyed legacy rows count individually.
- `crates/hh-results/src/projection.rs` — the `control.budget.consumed`
  fold deduplicates identically; `consumption.dimensions` counts once.
- `crates/hh-budget/tests/r5_13.rs` — 9-leg AC battery over scratch
  `Store::open_test` runs; `crates/hh-results/tests/results.rs` —
  consumer regression through settle → `budget_utilization` and the
  row's `consumption.dimensions`.
- `docs/adr/ADR-0392-r5.13-physical-use-fold-landing.md` — owned landing
  decisions (view-only fold, leaf-most count-once, no revert exclusion,
  two-class unknown fold, `charged_to` strata, billed = deduplicated
  spend rows, consumer dedup key, over-reservation in full); ADR index +
  REVISIT_TRIGGERS regenerated; BL-47 sources.

## Design decisions

- `incurred` applies `totals`' leaf-most rule **without** the revert
  exclusion — `totals` is the logical reversal; the physical view keeps
  the spend (B.1 item 4, B.5).
- Unknown exposure is a typed list surfaced as evidence, not a zero —
  `available:false`/missing `usage` is `n/a`, never 0 (ADR-0118 d.7).
- Dispatch *refusal* under unknown/unfunded exposure stays owed to
  R5.19 (prepared-call ordering) — this ticket owns the view it reads.
